_header.purpose: Master list of school/pre-university boards worldwide, for the board picker (apps/web-pwa/src/data/catalog.ts 'boards' array feeds apps/web-pwa/src/screens/you/GradeBoardPicker.tsx and BoardPicker). Extends the hand-picked 13-board list already there (CBSE, ICSE, Telangana, AP, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Kerala, UP, IB, Cambridge, Common Core, UK National Curriculum) with every Indian state board plus the major international pre-university qualifications, so the picker can show a real board instead of only the free-text 'my board isn't here' escape hatch.
_header.provenance: owner-supplied spreadsheet School_Boards_Syllabus_Catalog.xlsx, 2026-07-07, unverified. Board names/countries/categories are common-knowledge facts (easy to spot-check, low fabrication risk) — this file carries ONLY that board-identity metadata, not curriculum content.
_header.integration: Each entry: id/name/type(national|state|international)/country/region (country and region are currently identical — both pass through the spreadsheet's 'Country/Region' column; a future pass may want to split them, e.g. region='India' vs country='India' for state boards but region='International' for AP-USA). 'existingCatalogId' points at a board id already wired into content/catalogs/*.json + apps/web-pwa/src/data/frame.ts CATALOG_LOADERS when one exists; null means no chapter/topic catalog exists yet and the board should route through the same fetch-on-arrival / unsourceable path as any unlisted board today (see frame.ts ensureFrame). 'tier' flags boards that are Class 11-12 / pre-university only (all International Board rows, plus three Indian boards that split SSC and Intermediate into separate boards). This file does NOT replace apps/web-pwa/src/data/catalog.ts boards array — the universal-frame picker work should read from here and decide seeding/ordering; this file only supplies the raw board facts.
_header.excluded: The spreadsheet's second sheet ('Full Syllabus', 4232 rows of chapter/topic/subtopic per board+subject) was deliberately NOT ingested into any catalog. Reasons: (1) no source URL or provenance on any row, unlike every file in this directory which carries fetched:<url> or an explicit model-knowledge flag; (2) roughly a quarter of all topic cells are one generic 4-item template ('Core Concepts'/'Advanced Concepts'/'Applied Topics'/'Examination Preparation') copy-pasted across unrelated subjects and boards (100% of rows for AP-USA, German Abitur, Singapore-Cambridge GCE A-Level, American HS Diploma, and NIOS Vocational are this template, nothing else); (3) even the more detailed rows (e.g. Andhra Pradesh Intermediate Physics/Chemistry, which do look like real NCERT-aligned Class 11-12 content) have internally inconsistent chapter numbering (two unrelated chapters both labelled chapter 1); (4) 27 of the 44 boards have zero chapter/topic/subtopic rows at all — just a subject-per-stream list that duplicates the Boards Overview sheet already captured here. It fails this project's sourcing bar and would need full re-verification against each board's real syllabus PDF before it could go anywhere near content/catalogs/*.json chapter data.
